campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from BU Housing's official undergraduate residence pages. BU publishes the exact room layouts available in every residence (traditional, suite, semi-suite, studio and apartment) and provides floor plans, but no dimensions in text, so every room here uses the site's estimate fallback and is labelled "Estimated based on similar rooms. Official size not published." BU's housing system is unusually varied: brownstone apartments, large traditional towers and full apartments all sit within a few blocks, so the residence matters more than the room type alone. Beds are Twin XL.
